x: the official gazette of belgrave harriers Front Cover; Gary Staines takes off in the last lap of the AAA's Indoor 3000m to win from Billy Dee of Luton.

It hadn't been Gary's long term objective to go for the AAA 3000 metres but a last minute decision to test how the Winter's training was going provided a bonus when he took the title from Billy Dee and ten others in a pb and new club indoor best of 8.04.72.
